name: Tsurumi Sayaka
source:
A married office worker with a chaste image who works in the general affairs department. 

She married her husband through an arranged marriage, but is frustrated by their lack ofnighttime activities.

At that time, she witnesses the scene of intense sex of the main character...

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5638]official site[/url]]
